title: specification-capture input contract
description: Input contract for the specification-capture skill. The skill captures non-goals, failure modes, interface contracts, and a risk map for an issue and persists them to the decision journal (shape: plugins/flow/references/specification-journal-format.md). The specFirst.riskMap toggle is read from the settings cascade by the skill, not passed here. See plugins/flow/skills/specification-capture/SKILL.md for the skill's full process.

issueContext.description: The issue context the skill parses for prior specification statements.

body.description: The full issue body. The skill scans this for non-goals/failure-modes/interface-contracts/risk-map cues.

comments.description: All comments on the issue in chronological order.

journalPath.description: Path to the decision journal file where the captured specification is persisted. Typically `.decisions/issue-{N}.md`.

invocationReason.description: Which command invoked the skill. Used to scope which elements the skill focuses on (start needs all four, risk map exempt only when specFirst.riskMap is false; design needs non-goals + interface contracts, risk map recommended; brainstorm needs non-goals only).
